# RootS Outcomes: Reports, Papers and Presentations 

This page provides a comprehensive overview of the key outcomes and deliverables generated by the RootS research network, including published papers, technical reports, and presentations from conferences and workshops. The content is organized to facilitate easy access to the most relevant materials for researchers, practitioners, and stakeholders interested in Soil-Vegetation-Atmosphere (SVA) interactions and their geotechnical implications.
